children: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd. (ROHL), through its subsidiary Regenta Hotels Private Limited, has launched Regenta Hubballi, strengthening its presence in Karnataka. Located on Gokul Main Road beside the Deshpande Foundation, the hotel is positioned within Hubballi’s commercial corridor and is aimed at business and leisure travellers.
The 117-key property offers rooms and suites across Deluxe, Executive, Premium and Suite categories. Guest amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, a minibar, electronic safe and tea and coffee maker.

The hotel includes PINXX, a multi-cuisine all-day dining restaurant, and MIX, a lounge serving beverages and light bites. Its meetings and events facilities comprise Magnolia Hall, spread across 2,580 sq. ft., and Magestic Hall, covering 2,480 sq. ft. Anugraha Hall offers 7,000 sq. ft. of space for weddings, receptions and conferences, while Anugraha Lawn provides 6,000 sq. ft. of outdoor event space. The property also has Runway Rooftop, a 6,500 sq. ft. open-air venue on the sixth floor.
The hotel is located approximately 8 km from Hubballi Junction Railway Station and offers wellness facilities alongside other guest amenities.

Keshav Baljee, Whole Time Director, Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd. added: “Regenta Hubballi represents our focused approach to growing in high-potential urban centres that combine strong business demand with lifestyle appeal. This 117-key property - with its thoughtfully designed rooms, extensive banquet and outdoor venues, and contemporary dining experiences - perfectly aligns with the evolving expectations of today’s travellers. We are excited to strengthen our presence in Karnataka and look forward to delivering memorable stays.”
